description: This file is a runtime utility script that acts as a proxy for MCP (Master Control Program) commands. It decodes payloads, rewrites certain JSON lines to inject MCP server information, spawns child processes to run commands, and manages IO streams, primarily to facilitate MCP communication and bridging.

methods.name: decodePayload
methods.description: Decodes the --payload argument, parsing the JSON payload and extracting the targetCommand and mcpServers array.

methods.name: shouldInject
methods.description: Determines whether a method name is one of the session-related methods ('session/new', 'session/load', 'session/fork') that should have MCP servers injected.

methods.name: rewriteLine
methods.description: Parses a line of JSON, and if it matches expected method and parameters, injects the MCP server list into the params.

methods.name: isMainModule
methods.description: Checks if this script is executed as the main module to decide whether to run the main function.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main execution flow: decodes payload, spawns the target process, rewrites lines for MCP servers, manages IPC streams, and handles process lifecycle.
